title: M-E092826-01 ERCOT MOTE will be open for DST testing

documents.text:
Market Notice Details

To:

Notice_Operations@lists.ercot.com,Notice_Release_Retail@lists.ercot.com,Notice_Release_Wholesale@lists.ercot.com

Sent:

9/28/26, 2:28 PM

Subject:

M-E092826-01 ERCOT MOTE will be open for DST testing

NOTICE DATE:
 September 28, 2026

NOTICE TYPE:
 M-E092826-01 Operations

SHORT DESCRIPTION:
 ERCOT MOTE will be open for DST testing

INTENDED AUDIENCE:
 All Market Participants

DAYS AFFECTED:
 October 5, 2026 - October 9, 2026

LONG DESCRIPTION:
 The ERCOT Market Operations Test Environment (MOTE) will be available for Market Participant Daylight Saving Time (DST) testing as listed in the table below. There is only one period for testing this year. The testing period will be from Monday through Friday and will follow the simulated times shown in the table.

Real Time

Simulated Time

MOTE System

Mon 10/5/2026 2 PM

Fri 10/30/2026 2 AM CDT

MOTE Servers Normal Time change to DST Time

Mon 10/5/2026 5 PM

Fri 10/30/2026 5 AM CDT

Start testing QSE submissions for next 5 days including Long Day 11/1/2026

Mon 10/5/2026 10 PM

Fri 10/30/2026 10 AM CDT

DAM close for Operating Day 10/31/2026

Tue 10/6/2026 10 PM

Sat 10/31/2026 10 AM CDT

DAM close for Operating Day 11/1/2026 (Long DST Day)

Wed 10/7/2026 1 PM

Sun 11/1/2026 1 AM CDT

CDT Time

Wed 10/7/2026 2 PM

Sun 11/1/2026 1* AM

DST Transition Time/Repeated Hour

Wed 10/7/2026 3 PM

Sun 11/1/2026 2 AM CST

End of Repeated hour - CST

Wed 10/7/2026 11 PM

Sun 11/1/2026 10 AM CST

DAM close for Operating Day 11/2/2026

Fri 10/9/2026 2 PM

Tue 11/3/2026 9 PM CST

Close of Test and MOTE Servers DST Time Change to Normal Time

ACTION REQUIRED:
 MPs requested to participate in market and outage submission testing leading up to the DST transition and ensure no issues observed during and after the transition.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:
 For information regarding submissions, including DST requirements, please refer to the latest version of EIP external specifications documentation and the most recent External Web Services XSDs located on the ERCOT developer portal (
https://developer.ercot.com/
).

For MOTE testing, the URL for XML submissions is: 
https://testmisapi.ercot.com/NodalAPI/EWS/

The URL for UI submissions is: 
https://testmis.ercot.com/mmsui/mmsui/displayTradesLanding.action

The following are examples of how the Long DST Day November 01, 2026 will be labeled:

0100

0200 (Normal Hour)

0200* (Repeated Hour)

0300

0400

0500

CONTACT:
 If you have any questions, please contact your ERCOT Account Manager. You may also call the general ERCOT Client Services phone number at (512) 248-3900 or contact ERCOT Client Services via email at 
ClientServices@ercot.com
.

If you are receiving email from a public ERCOT distribution list that you no longer wish to receive, please follow this link in order to unsubscribe from this list: 
http://lists.ercot.com
.
